title: loctree.prism.v1
description: Canonical wire shape emitted by `loct prism --json` and the `loctree-mcp` `prism` tool. Consumed by `vc-polarize` runner (vibecrafted/skills/vc-agents/shell/vetcoders.sh) and `vc-operator` (src/polarize.rs) for band-action gating (0..4 abort / 5..8 memo / 9..12 pass / 13..15 doctrine). Schema bumps require a new version string and a refreshed golden fixture under `loctree-rs/tests/fixtures/`.

schema_version.description: Pinned schema identifier. Consumers MUST fail closed on unknown values.

project_root.description: Canonical (canonicalized when possible) absolute path to the project the prism scoring was computed against.

tasks.description: Task framings supplied to prism. At least two entries are required for overlap scoring.

total_score.description: Sum of the five axis scores. Drives band-action mapping in downstream consumers.

band.description: Human-readable band label (English). Authoritative numeric thresholds: 0..4, 5..8, 9..12, 13..15. Action keywords (abort/memo/pass/doctrine) are derived from the score by consumers; this string is the operator-facing summary.

axes.description: Per-axis score breakdown. Five axes always present in a fixed order: spread, runtime_centrality, authority_diversity, drift_risk, closure_evidence.

task_summaries.description: One summary per task framing. Order matches `tasks`.

recommendation.description: Human-readable English recommendation from loctree. NOT the action keyword consumed by gating logic — that is derived from `total_score`.

score.description: Per-axis score. Sum of the five axes equals `total_score`.

evidence.description: Free-form evidence strings supporting the score. Stable order, language-tagged where applicable.

task.description: Task framing string as supplied to prism.

memory_entry_count.description: Aicx memory entries linked to this task framing (0 if aicx disabled or unreachable).

low_lexical_memory_count.description: Memory entries flagged as low-lexical (drift risk signal).

surface_kinds.description: Surface taxonomy union for this task: code / runtime / tests / docs / etc.

top_files.description: Files most central to this task framing, sorted by relevance.

verification_gates.description: Verification gate strings touching this task surface (e.g. `cargo test`, `pnpm vitest`).

likely_tests.description: Test files likely covering this task framing, by static heuristic.

cache_scope.description: Snapshot/index cache scope for this task at scoring time.

stale_snapshot.description: True if loctree snapshot used for this task summary is older than the working tree's last edit.

dirty_worktree.description: True if the working tree had uncommitted changes affecting files in `top_files` at scoring time.

union_files.description: Cardinality of the union of `top_files` across all task summaries.

shared_files_all_tasks.description: Cardinality of the intersection of `top_files` across all task summaries.

average_pairwise_jaccard.description: Average pairwise Jaccard similarity over `top_files` sets; 1.0 means identical task framings, 0.0 means fully disjoint surfaces.
